arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/extensions.md'; s=open(p).read()
old="""    extensions: |
      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0   # pit's typescript tool (pit/durable)
```"""
new="""    extensions: |
      # pit's typescript tool (pit/durable)
      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0
```"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
old2="Write one extension per line, or separate them with commas. pi-action ignores empty lines and lines that start with `#`:"
new2="Write one extension per line, or separate them with commas. pi-action ignores empty lines and lines that start with `#`. Do not put a comment after a spec on the same line: pi-action reads it as part of the spec, and the run fails."
assert old2 in s; s=s.replace(old2,new2+"\n\nExample:")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "Example:" -B3 docs/extensions.md | head
